text:
alex: Quick heads-up — proposing a pin of runtime v3.4.1 for hosted inference tomorrow morning. Wanted to compress the usual 1h window to a 30m window (02:15–02:45 UTC) because EU infra has a maintenance slot at 03:00 and we need cross-region handoff. Can ops sign off?

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot queued: pin runtime:v3.4.1 -> pinlist (staged). Target window pending manual confirm. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/7423459999 :robot_face:

mira: :eyes: what's the reason for pin vs soft-unpin? we had regressions last month when we unpinned longseq models.

alex: We saw a 10% tail latency spike for longseqs during the staggered unpin last week. This pin is temporary while the runtime team lands a small K/V cache change. Intend to lift after health signals look stable.

lei: heads-up: SDK 2.8.0 emits a new http header (x-rdinfer-features) that runtime 3.4.1 will start relying on for routing micro-optimizations. If any prod clients are on 2.7.x they might hit a routing mismatch and slightly higher latency. Recommend we include an SDK compatibility note and a short grace period.

sam: ops + oncall here — if we squeeze the window we need a rollback runbook. Proposal: 1) if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p50 latency regresses > 25% vs baseline -> immediate rollback to 3.3.9; 2) if tail p99 spikes > 2x for 10m escalate to eng-runtime. Agreed?

taylor: agree with runbook. Also request a canary across eu-west before global pin. 10% traffic to eu-west for 15m, then hold. If green, expand.

alex: plan updated: canary eu-west @ 02:15 for 15m at 10% traffic. Global apply @ 02:35 if canary green. Pin window 02:15–02:45 still.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot: canary created -> eu-west (10% traffic) for runtime:v3.4.1 at 02:15 UTC. will auto-notify channel on health.

mira: FYI, perf telemetry shows a small memory bump on 3.4.1 in canary runs yesterday, but it plateaued after 8 minutes. suggest we keep memory alert thresholds slightly higher for the canary to avoid noisy alarms.

lei: I'll draft the SDK note now and ping mobile teams. Quick blurb: "SDK >=2.8 recommended for runtime v3.4.1 due to routing header changes; clients on 2.7 will still function but may see increased latency on some traffic patterns."

sam: ops checklist: 1) preflight smoke at 02:10 (health endpoints), 2) router config snapshot, 3) eviction thresholds increased by 5% for canary. I'll put these in the runbook.

alex: tagging @mira @lei @sam - assign owners: mira owns the health gating config, sam owns runbook and threshold changes, lei owns SDK communication. I'll own rollout decision and rollback.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot: pin request acknowledged. Please react with :thumbsup: to confirm owners and start preflight.

mira: :thumbsup: starting health gating config now.

lei: :thumbsup: drafting SDK note, will post PR in docs in 10m.

sam: :thumbsup: runbook updated and linked in ops playbook. I'll trigger the preflight message 02:05 UTC.

taylor: adding a quick query for longseq tail latency to the canary dashboard now.

alex: thanks all — I'll watch the canary and post a short status update at 02:35. If no objections I'll flip the global pin after the canary green.

mira: One more thing — if we see the memory bump reoccur within the first 5 minutes of canary, do we auto-abort or roll back?

sam: auto-abort threshold: memory per-worker > +12% sustained for 5m -> abort canary and rollback. We'll also collect heap dumps if triggered.

alex: noted. Good catch.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot: preflight check scheduled 02:05 UTC. Notifications will follow. Good luck :rocket:
